english.title: Licensor / pub operating business fail to maintain and retain records of packaging waste - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a producer of packaging waste who was a

(A)_[licensor of a trade mark,]_
(B)_[pub operating business,]_

failed to maintain for each data collection period, and retain for at least 7 years after the end of that data collection period, records of information referred to in paragraph 20(d) Schedule 1 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16(6) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
